practical_exercises.title: First Query
practical_exercises.description: Select all columns from a sample students table and then select only names and marks.

practical_exercises.title: Filtering Records
practical_exercises.description: Find products above a specified price and students who achieved a given minimum score.

practical_exercises.title: Sorting and Limiting
practical_exercises.description: Display the five highest-priced products in descending order.

practical_exercises.title: Distinct Values
practical_exercises.description: List unique product categories and customer cities.

practical_exercises.title: Operator Practice
practical_exercises.description: Find employees whose salaries fall within a range and whose departments match specified conditions.

practical_exercises.title: String Functions
practical_exercises.description: Normalize names, remove surrounding spaces, and extract parts of email addresses.

practical_exercises.title: Date Functions
practical_exercises.description: Find orders created within a date range and calculate the age of records.

practical_exercises.title: NULL Handling
practical_exercises.description: Identify customers with missing phone numbers and replace missing display values appropriately.

practical_exercises.title: Aggregate Functions
practical_exercises.description: Calculate the total inventory, average product price, and number of customers.

practical_exercises.title: Basic Joins
practical_exercises.description: Display orders with their customer names and products with their category names.

practical_exercises.title: Multi-Table Reports
practical_exercises.description: Generate a report showing each customer, their number of orders, and their total purchase value.

practical_exercises.title: Outer Joins
practical_exercises.description: Find customers who have never ordered and products that have never been sold.

practical_exercises.title: Subqueries
practical_exercises.description: Identify products priced above the overall average price.

practical_exercises.title: Set Operations
practical_exercises.description: Compare two lists of customers and find shared and distinct records.

practical_exercises.title: Conditional Aggregation
practical_exercises.description: Calculate completed, pending, and cancelled orders in one report.

practical_exercises.title: CTEs
practical_exercises.description: Divide a complicated monthly revenue query into readable query stages.

practical_exercises.title: Window Functions
practical_exercises.description: Rank employees within departments and find the second-highest salary in each department.

practical_exercises.title: Running Totals
practical_exercises.description: Calculate cumulative sales by date.

practical_exercises.title: Constraints
practical_exercises.description: Design tables that reject duplicate emails, negative quantities, and invalid foreign keys.

practical_exercises.title: Transactions
practical_exercises.description: Transfer an amount between two account records, committing only when every required operation succeeds.

practical_exercises.title: Data Cleaning
practical_exercises.description: Detect duplicate customers and inconsistent text values.

practical_exercises.title: Pagination
practical_exercises.description: Implement predictable pagination using a unique sort key.

practical_exercises.title: Top-N per Group
practical_exercises.description: Find the three best-selling products in each category.

practical_exercises.title: Gaps and Islands
practical_exercises.description: Identify consecutive days of activity for each user.

practical_exercises.title: Analytical Reporting
practical_exercises.description: Calculate monthly growth, running averages, and percentage contributions.

practical_exercises.title: Query Optimization
practical_exercises.description: Compare execution plans before and after introducing an appropriate index.

practical_exercises.title: Concurrency Testing
practical_exercises.description: Demonstrate and resolve a lost-update scenario.

practical_exercises.title: Recursive Queries
practical_exercises.description: Traverse a multilevel employee hierarchy.

practical_exercises.title: Security Testing
practical_exercises.description: Create restricted database roles and verify that unauthorized queries are denied.

practical_exercises.title: Data Synchronization
practical_exercises.description: Import external records into staging tables, validate them, and synchronize the destination tables.

practical_exercises.title: Performance Benchmarking
practical_exercises.description: Compare alternative query structures using representative datasets.

practical_exercises.title: Dialect Compatibility
practical_exercises.description: Rewrite a query using portable SQL when its original syntax is database- specific. validation conditions, solution editor, and an explanation of common mistakes.

learning_roadmap.title: Foundations and setup
learning_roadmap.milestone: Create a local practice database and explain its tables and relationships.

learning_roadmap.title: Everyday querying
learning_roadmap.milestone: Build multi-table reports with filters, functions, aggregates, and joins.

learning_roadmap.title: Intermediate and analytical SQL
learning_roadmap.milestone: Solve subquery, CTE, window, ranking, and running-total tasks.

learning_roadmap.title: Database construction and correctness
learning_roadmap.milestone: Build a normalized database with integrity checks and transactions.

learning_roadmap.title: Professional SQL
learning_roadmap.milestone: Deliver a tested, secure, performance-reviewed database project.

learning_roadmap.title: Advanced specialization
learning_roadmap.milestone: Complete a capstone and document architecture trade-offs.

specialization_categories.name: Core SQL
specialization_categories.focus: Data types, CRUD, filtering, functions, joins, aggregates, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, constraints, transactions

specialization_categories.name: Professional SQL
specialization_categories.focus: Security, query plans, indexes, migrations, automated testing, application integration, concurrency

specialization_categories.name: Database-specific extensions
specialization_categories.focus: PL/pgSQL, T-SQL, PL/SQL, dialect-specific upserts, procedural routines, generated columns, specialized indexes

specialization_categories.name: Data engineering
specialization_categories.focus: Bulk loading, staging, ETL/ELT, incremental processing, reconciliation, change data capture

specialization_categories.name: Analytics and BI
specialization_categories.focus: Analytical SQL, dimensional modeling, window calculations, advanced aggregation, reporting

specialization_categories.name: Database administration
specialization_categories.focus: Roles, permissions, backup/recovery, schema maintenance, monitoring, resource management

specialization_categories.name: Specialized data
specialization_categories.focus: JSON, full-text search, spatial data, temporal history, hierarchical queries, distributed SQL
